visualCharacteristics.purpose: Brand story intro: text column (heading, subheading, paragraph, CTA) beside a video poster that plays an embedded video
visualCharacteristics.layout: Two equal columns on desktop, text left and video right; video stacks below the text on mobile; optional product image in the text cell floats over the column seam into the next band from 768px

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 heading, subheading, paragraph, CTA link; cell 2 poster image plus a YouTube/Vimeo link (the image may be linked directly). Without a video link the image renders as a plain image

reuseGuidance: Use when one column is a video poster. For text beside a stat graphic use columns-stat; for a tiled grid use columns-mosaic.
